item.text: {"question_id":"8B.10","answer":"By the end of 2023, López Obrador had converted important elements of his stated 4T portfolio into operating programs, formal rules, expanded transfers, and military-administered infrastructure, but the evidence does not establish broad durable achievement across the portfolio. The elderly pension expanded from about 5 million beneficiaries in 2018 to 10.8 million in 2022, and CONEVAL found lower overall poverty and food, housing, and some older-person deprivation, while noting that transfers contributed to the poverty reduction without isolating all causes (BATCH-0032-E006; BATCH-0032-E002; BATCH-0032-E004; BATCH-0032-E009). The 2023 minimum-wage increase and IMSS-BIENESTAR operating rules show concrete policy and institutional conversion, but the latter establishes design and authority rather than service outcomes (BATCH-0031-E008; BATCH-0051-E001). The administration also established or expanded military roles in infrastructure and the National Guard, yet the Maya Train opened only partially, with delays, sharply higher estimated costs, uncertain operating-cost coverage, and incomplete construction; audit findings also left major 2023 expenditures and property acquisitions unsubstantiated (BATCH-0029-E007; BATCH-0030-E004; BATCH-0040-E008). Durability and capacity were further qualified by the Supreme Court's 2023 invalidation of the National Guard's transfer of administrative, budgetary, organizational, functional, and command control to Defense, and by the 2023 failure of INAI to function fully amid unresolved appointments and calls for its dissolution (BATCH-0055-E008; BATCH-0026-E020). End-period monitoring found that only half of 16 priority programs measured results adequately, four did not measure results, half required stronger logical association, and monitoring recommendations were disregarded to varying degrees (BATCH-0052-E004; BATCH-0052-E006; BATCH-0054-E006). Outcomes were correspondingly mixed: health-access deprivation rose sharply from 2018 to 2022 during the Seguro Popular–Insabi transition, while justice capacity and performance deteriorated or stagnated through 2023, including fewer prosecutorial personnel and resources, more pending investigations, overcrowding, and impunity above 90% (BATCH-0032-E003; BATCH-0016-E010). The World Bank's contemporaneous review likewise recorded only eight of 24 partnership objective indicators achieved, with ten off track, alongside cancellations, shifting priorities, institutional turnover, and implementation constraints; this is corroborative but not a complete measure of the Mexican state (BATCH-0052-E014; BATCH-0052-E015; BATCH-0052-E020). The defensible conclusion is therefore mixed and durability-limited: substantial conversion occurred in transfers, wage policy, selected institutional arrangements, and visible infrastructure, but many material objectives lacked demonstrated durable outcomes, effective capacity, coherent measurement, or continuity by the period end. Causal attribution remains qualified by inherited conditions, the pandemic, external and subnational factors, subordinate resistance, and institutional constraints. The evidence does not establish López Obrador's personal responsibility for every institutional or aggregate outcome. Moral approval or disapproval of these objectives did not affect this execution
